reason: A scheduled-task plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web Profile that creates recurring or one-time agent sessions, including optional execution during Beijing off-peak hours, with persistent state and task APIs.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web Profile 提供支持定时、每日重复和空闲时段执行的任务调度功能。
summaries.en: Provides scheduled and daily task execution for the DeepSeek Harness Web Profile, with optional deferral to Beijing off-peak hours.

capabilities: Launches isolated agent sessions to execute scheduled prompts
Persists task state and runs a serialized scheduler
Exposes HTTP endpoints for creating and listing tasks
Defers execution based on Beijing peak and off-peak hours
